gates.name: MODEL EQUATION SURFACE COMPLETE
gates.requirement: all 16 shipped models are accounted for

evidence.method: every equation worked term by term in the ledger; a passing numerical test was not accepted as evidence anywhere, because a wrong power of a unit can match a reference at the one point it was built at
residuals measured explicitly, never inferred from the equations looking right

gates.name: CONSERVATION
gates.requirement: all applicable conservation checks pass, with the residual measured

gates.name: LIMITING BEHAVIOR
gates.requirement: all material applicable limits behave correctly

evidence.expected_order_source: the implemented scheme, not an invented expectation; the spatial ladder has the constant time-error floor removed before its order is read
evidence.observed_orders: 1.00 in time (backward Euler), 2.00 in space (central differences)
evidence.predicted_vs_observed_error: the reference solves match the scheme's own predicted error to about one per cent, which is a stronger statement than being inside a tolerance

gates.name: NUMERICAL ACCURACY / CONVERGENCE
gates.requirement: numerical methods meet the accuracy their own scheme justifies

evidence.finding: no repository pair is fully independent: all five share the problem statement. None shares numerics, and the one pair that imports the route it checks takes only two metric-name strings from it. This audit's own six oracles import no engcore at all
evidence.method: module import closure parsed from the AST, not read from docstrings

gates.name: SOLVER INDEPENDENCE
gates.requirement: claimed independent evidence routes are independent enough to support the claim

searched_by: every reference case above is a search: an independent oracle against a runtime the tests already accept
randomized property testing over the declared domain of five model families, 660 admissible draws
an exact conservation invariant on every applicable model
a 50-digit arithmetic on the one closed-form model

gates.name: ZERO KNOWN FALSE AGREEMENT
gates.requirement: no case remains where the implementation, its tests and its record agree while an independent oracle disagrees

gates.name: AUDITOR VALIDITY
gates.requirement: planted scientific defects are detected and audit mistakes are adjudicated openly

evidence.not_evidence_of_scientific_truth: an unchanged digest says the code is the same code, not that its equations are right. The two are different layers and this gate speaks only for the first
evidence.why_no_reruns_were_needed: this round changed no file under src/ or tests/ at all, so the 79-mutant suite, both benchmark scorecards and both earlier guard suites are evaluating byte-identical code. The guard suites were run anyway

gates.name: PREVIOUS ASSURANCE PRESERVED
gates.requirement: Contract Guard, Capability Boundary and the certified scientific assurance remain valid

evidence.method: every artifact named in benchmarks/blind_v2/FREEZE.json re-hashed against the value that manifest records, and git asked separately whether any path under benchmarks/blind_v2 changed. No Blind V2 frozen/sealed artifact path changed.

gates.name: FROZEN EVIDENCE PRESERVED
gates.requirement: Blind V2 frozen/sealed artifacts remain untouched

layers_kept_separate: B. contract integrity and contract guard
D. scientific truth and numerical oracle validation (this round)
note: A NEW gate set. The Blind V2, Contract Integrity, Contract Guard and Capability Boundary gates are not modified, reused or renumbered; they answered different questions and their results stand.
what_these_gates_do_not_say: That the models are the right models for any particular purpose. They say that the equations each model implements are the equations its physics requires, that the implementation computes them correctly, that the numerics converge at the order the scheme justifies, and that independent mathematics agrees.
